cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Screen-space Ground-Truth Ambient Occlusion (GTAO) in Unreal Engine 5, Call of Duty, and Unity HDRP
Explaining why unweighted solid-angle SSAO (1 - cos γ) over-darkens a 45° street canyon by -41.42% (0.2929 vs 0.5000)
Weighting horizon visibility slices by the Lambertian cos θ factor via the closed-form ½(1 - cos 2γ) = sin² γ antiderivative
Replacing 64-ring hemispherical cosine-weighted quadrature with a single closed-form trigonometric evaluation
not_for: Isotropic volumetric fog particles in mid-air that have no surface normal N or Lambertian cosine law
Unlit flat-shaded cartoon scenes where ambient occlusion is intentionally disabled
Neural screen-space GI or DeepAO inference models
Off-screen occluders outside the camera depth buffer frustum (which require ray-traced or world-space SDF AO)
